etymologies.etymologyHTML: From bed +‎ room.

definitions.definition: A room in a house, apartment, hotel or other dwelling where a bed is kept for sleeping.

quote.citation: 1963, Margery Allingham, “The Elopers”, in The China Governess: A Mystery, London: Chatto & Windus, →OCLC, page 33:
quote.text: The huge square box, parquet-floored and high-ceilinged, had been arranged to display a suite of bedroom furniture designed and made in the halcyon days of the last quarter of the nineteenth century, […].

I am in the bedroom.

quote.text: If you’re single, you might be going through a dry spell, or if you’re taken, life in the bedroom has become more routine and less of a spontaneous, fun activity.
